# Verità

> Verità is an iOS app that gives honest, personalized verdicts on beauty products. Scan a barcode, snap a photo, or search a product; Verità weighs ingredients and genuine review coverage against your skin and hair profile and answers plainly: worth it, or skip it — including when the answer is no.

- Free, currently in open beta via TestFlight: https://testflight.apple.com/join/ReC68vTJ
- No fake reviews, no invented data, no paid placements. Brands cannot pay for verdicts.
- Shop links may earn a commission; verdicts are generated before and independently of any link.
- Built by Sofia Piniella in Miami, 2026.

## Site
- https://askverita.com/ : product overview, real example verdicts, how it works
- https://askverita.com/privacy : privacy policy
